description: Eerie thick fog suddenly descends, all four vehicles' tires burst simultaneously, Don Quixote is stabbed to death, the investigators experience their first real permanent loss for the first time, heading to the hospital to handle the aftermath

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Turk C snorted coldly, standing shoulder to shoulder with the other two as they scanned the area. He wiped the blood from his face and said calmly, "I don't want to embarrass anyone either. Come with us quietly!" Three blood-stained daggers gleamed coldly in the wind.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Surrender

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: player6's blood meandered into dark red streams between the stone slabs. The Bora wind whipped the tatters of her coat against player4's legs. The blood splattered on everyone's faces gradually congealed into deep brown star-like spots. The black car's engine was still idling, humming low like a beast waiting for its prey.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Get in the car

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: #Look around the outside street, searching for traces of the Blackshirts

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Bolan caught sight of several Blackshirts smoking and chatting at a distant alley entrance.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: #Jog over and point towards the crime scene, using hand gestures to indicate there was a fight and injuries over there.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: The Blackshirts lazily glanced in that direction. At that moment, the black car suddenly accelerated, its tires screeching against the pavement as it lurched forward.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #Push the burly man aside to let him go report back, then leap onto the car.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "...Who are you? How do you know us? Where are you taking us?"

conversation.speaker: player7
conversation.text: #With a heart full of grief, pick up Little Tang, hail a taxi, and rush to the hospital.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: The Turkish leader chuckled lightly. "Who we are isn't important. What's important is that statue. Our companions should have succeeded at your hotel by now, probably on their way back with the item." He spoke while lightly tapping the window edge with his finger.

conversation.speaker: player7
conversation.text: #Wipe tears

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Oh, okay."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Thick white fog suddenly filled the car cabin. The driving Turk cursed, muttering about how such heavy fog could appear suddenly with this strong Bora wind. The fog quickly enveloped the entire windshield, visibility dropping extremely low.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "We were also hired..."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: The driving Turk slammed the steering wheel and cursed, "Damn it, where did all this fog come from? This cursed wind is annoying enough! Shit!" Someone in the back seat complained, "This is really spooky, it was clear just a moment ago." Another voice mumbled, "This fog is so thick you can't even see the road signs."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "With fog this thick, we might crash..."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: #The professor half-kneels beside the student. His movements are slow, almost ritualistically deliberate. First, he uses a clean white handkerchief to meticulously wipe away the blood and splattered mud from the student's face. Through the cloth, his fingertips can feel the unnatural coldness and stiffness beneath the skin. This causes an almost imperceptible hesitation in his wiping motion, but then he continues, as if gently brushing away this final indignity and filth...

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: The vehicle drove into a dimly lit alley. The Turkish leader said impatiently, "What crash? We're almost there, just wait." The tires made a soft sound passing over puddles. The fog lights cast two blurry beams in the thick fog.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Quietly shut up

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Suddenly, all the tires burst simultaneously. The vehicle careened out of control, the tire rims scraping against the cobblestone road with a piercing shriek. The Turks cursed in unison. Someone yelled in their native language, "What happened?" Another panicked and grabbed the overhead handrail.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: #Adjusting the student's torn collar, fastening the crooked buttons one by one, smoothing out the wrinkles on the jacket. Every movement is precise, carrying the specific focus and reverence of an archaeologist handling precious relics.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "See? Something happened."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: #It seems only this kind of procedural rigor can barely contain the silent, lung-tearing, dull ache in the chest...

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: The vehicle slammed into the alley wall. The Turkish leader kicked the door open and cursed, "Damn it, should've gotten a new car long ago." Rubbing his sore shoulder, he stepped out of the car. The other three Turks also stumbled out.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Also got out of the car.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: A figure slowly materialized in the fog. The Turkish leader squinted and shouted, "Who's there? Stop!" He instinctively reached for the dagger at his back. The other two Turks immediately tensed up, adopting defensive stances.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: #Take off the jacket. After everything is arranged properly, slowly pull the fabric up to cover. As the cloth passes over those eyes that will never open again, the hand finally trembles uncontrollably...

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Hide behind the Turkish man

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: #The clothes completely covered the youthful face. The professor leaned down and whispered something to the lifeless body in an extremely low voice—perhaps a name, perhaps an apology—light as a sigh, vanishing into the thick night as soon as it was uttered.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: A cheerful humming sound came from the fog. The other party spun on tiptoe, crimson pupils gleaming in the mist. "Oh dear~" He tapped the dented car roof with his fingernail. "Who allowed you to touch my toy?"

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: #Stand up, back straight, walk to the sink, vigorously scrub hands with cold water, over and over, water splashing coldly, stand there silently, staring at the corpse, for a long time...

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: The other party suddenly bowed elegantly, fog swirling into a vortex around him. "Almost forgot to introduce myself~" He tilted his head, revealing sharp teeth. "I am Fenanik, a 400-year-old art connoisseur." Suddenly, he lifted the Turkish leader's chin with his fingertip. "You brutes," his voice turned icy cold, "dare to ruin my meticulously trained toys!"

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: He showed up directly... how can we fight a vampire...

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: I will definitely make them pay...

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Fenanik chuckled and snapped his fingers. The Turkish leader suddenly stabbed his own eye socket with his dagger. Before the second Turk could react, Fenanik's fingers pierced his chest, instantly draining him into a shriveled husk. The other two retreated in terror. The vampire transformed into a swarm of bats diving down, their sharp teeth precisely severing the carotid arteries. The last bat flew into the fog carrying a blood-stained dagger. The alley was left with only four corpses in various poses and Fenanik's parting words: "Do your best, I look forward to your next performance, hahahaha" (.sc 1/1d6)

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Eh... another Sanity check? I understand, everyone's watching.

conversation.speaker: player7
conversation.text: #Sitting by the hospital chair, puffing on a cigarette, busy with Xiao Tang's funeral arrangements

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Eh... another Sanity check? I understand, everyone's watching.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Good news"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "What's done is done,"

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "The tires are flat"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Not far away, a short, sharp scream came, suddenly falling silent like a snapped string.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Try to fix the car

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: player4 checked and found all four tires completely flat, with obvious tears on the sidewalls. He searched the trunk but only found an empty toolbox and some rusted chains; even the basic jack was incomplete.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Looks like it can't be fixed"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Not far away, a "Who are you?" challenge was heard, followed by an even more piercing scream, then everything fell silent.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Silence

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "The wheels aren't broken, just not broken"

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Are we really a match for that thing"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Drive it to a repair shop, and this thing is ours"

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Makes sense"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: From the source of the two screams came the sound of something heavy collapsing with a crash, shaking the ground slightly like a whole row of shelves being toppled.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Who cares about this or that, can you even run?"

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "I don't want to do this anymore"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Fine, I'll buy you a plane ticket"

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Go check the source of the sound

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Right now, the only one who can't get away is Professor Bolan. If you want to leave," #claps hands "it's not really a difficult matter." #stares

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: player4 and Gungnir follow the sound to a dilapidated boarding house. The mottled exterior wall is lined with windows for over twenty rooms. The main door is ajar. A second-floor window is shattered inward as if blasted open by a cannonball. A faint smell of decay wafts out from inside the doorway.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Smell of decay?"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Old Man Fei, have you left!"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: player5's question is torn to shreds by the Bora wind, only the howling wind rushes into the dilapidated apartment's doors and windows.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: Then maybe we should go in and take a look.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Seems the old man doesn't want to talk to me." "What else can we do?"

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Go inside and look

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Inside the door lies the withered corpse of a Turk, his eyes staring emptily at the ceiling. On the stairs leading to the second floor, another desiccated corpse leans seated, its head tilted against the peeling wall plaster, fingers still frozen in a clawing gesture on the stair railing.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Check the cause of death

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Materials delivered right to our doorstep." "Old man's service is quite considerate."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Both corpses have four finger-sized holes on the side of their heads. The wound edges are as neat as if pressed by a mold, directly penetrating through to the other side of the skull.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Not drained of blood to death?" #Search around for things

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: (Go upstairs and search, then suspicious off) The cabinet door under the stairs is ajar. Inside, curled up, is a male corpse, its skin already beginning to rot and turn green. His chest cavity has been completely opened up, all organs are missing, and dark red bloody water has pooled in the empty cavity.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Eh... another Sanity check? I understand, everyone's watching. —————————————— <player5>'s Sanity Check: d100=81/73 Failure Sanity change: 73 ➯ 69 (deduct 1d4=4 points) -Life is only obtained by offering life.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Eh... another Sanity check? I understand, everyone's watching. —————————————— <player4>'s Sanity Check: d100=32/49 Success Sanity change: 49 ➯ 49 (deduct 0=0 points) -In the night, you possess an unseen world, and a clear self.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #Looks at player4 "By the way, when you collect bodies at the port, you must see quite a few like this, right?"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: player5 suddenly crouches down, vomit splattering on the dusty floor. His hands tremble as he supports himself on his knees, stomach acid mixed with lunch remnants continuously drips from the corner of his mouth.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Struck treasure." "Let's go upstairs and take a look."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #Wipes the corner of the mouth and continues searching

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: You enter the room with the blown-in window and see a third withered Turkish corpse slumped by the window. Inside the room, tables and chairs are overturned, bed sheets are torn into strips, glass fragments are scattered on the floor. Only on the desk sits a letter neatly pinned down by a dagger. The envelope has a smiley face doodle drawn in blood.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Not difficult to guess, probably Old Man Fei's doing." #Pick it up and look

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Letter to Salai (Turkish, but with an English translation written in blood beside it) Corpse Moon 5th, Flaying Calendar 1593 Salai, my brother, blessed by the Master, I have found part of the simulacrum! We have learned that the infidel army brought a fragment to Trieste. Trieste is home to a pitiful group of fools who worship a degenerate race residing there. Those believers are accustomed to bringing everything they find with magical power to their master, to appease the 'things' anger over their past failures. The fragment's history traces to Trieste and ends there, so it must have been taken to those creatures. You must take our brothers to Trieste, bring as many as you need. Surveil these believers and try to ascertain the location of the temples these people serve. The fragment is surely in one of them. If anyone tries to obstruct our glorious and great goal, before making the most appropriate and correct sacrifice of their blasphemous bodies, be sure to find out everything they know. Praise the Skinless One! S.M

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Qiduo received! Continuing to record for you the howling cold wind — Trieste 1923, currently 3070 text entries recorded, time elapsed 14 hours 7 minutes 30 seconds. Huh? A piece of paper flew out when opening the file. You love passionate kisses but never love people, practicing for pleasure but afraid of acquaintances. You love passing by to collect experiences, strangers hold a special appeal.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Last time, it was said that player4 and player5 came to the Skinwalker Brotherhood's hideout and found a letter. The other two, meanwhile, were dealing with player6's corpse.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #Clean face #Pats player4 "Can we get some human skin from those people?"
